Data.purpose: Séparer la collecte de formulaire de son canal d'envoi afin que champs, pièces jointes et audio restent provider-agnostic.

mailto_text.description: Ouvrir un client mail avec sujet/corps uniquement; aucune pièce jointe automatique fiable n'est supposée.

capability_negotiation.rule: The UI may collect files/audio even when the selected submission adapter cannot transmit them.
capability_negotiation.fallback: warn user and offer download/manual attachment rather than silently dropping binary data

rules: Attachment collection is independent from message transport.
Never promise automatic email attachments when using mailto.
Submission adapters declare binary support explicitly.
Sensitive payloads are never written into public static artifacts.

dictionnaire_donnees.note: Contrat d'envoi générique; les providers d'email/API restent des adaptateurs.
